about.headline: The platform that makes the night clear.
about.body: Afterdark connects events and audiences in one experience: real events, unambiguous tickets, and an interface that feels the night without dressing it up as a flyer.
about.imageAlt: Lit stage during a live show

atmosphere.support: Clear tickets, real dates, and a schedule you can read in seconds — before the first drop hits.
atmosphere.imageAlt: Crowd with hands in the air at a night show

1.title: Create your account
1.body: Register once. After that, every night is one tap away.

2.title: Choose the night
2.body: Browse dates, clubs, and tickets with the information that matters.

3.title: Ticket ready
3.body: Buy, confirm, and arrive knowing your place is already set.

clarity.headline: What matters, up front.
clarity.support: No visual noise. Just what you need to decide and arrive.

ticket.title: Unambiguous tickets
ticket.body: Type, price, and availability in one place. No hidden fine print.

secure.title: Access with backup
secure.body: Clear confirmation and a QR ready for the door. Less friction in line.

time.title: On-time schedule
time.body: Dates, times, and clubs you can scan fast — while there’s still room.

pulse.headline: Built for the night that’s already moving.
pulse.body: Afterdark doesn’t invent the scene — it organizes it. Discover, choose, and secure your place without losing the mood.
